name: Agention
description: Questions your agents ask you, from your own Agention server

settings.label: Server address
settings.hint: Your Agention server's origin, as you open it in a browser.

settings.label: API key
settings.hint: Create one in Agention's Settings → API keys with the scopes threads:write and sessions:read, copy it, then paste it here.

actions.label: Set up Agention in my agents
actions.description: Installs Agention's plugin, pinned to v0.6.0, in Claude Code and Codex (whichever you have).

actions.label: Install Agention's server here
actions.description: Installs Agention's server, v0.6.0, on this computer with npm. Only if you don't have a server yet; starting it is in the docs.

actions.label: Remove Agention from my agents
actions.description: Removes Agention's plugin marketplace, and with it the plugin, from Claude Code and Codex.
